_comment: Curated list for the /frameworks/ pages (scripts/frameworks_pages.py). Repository statistics live in data/frameworks_stats.json and are refreshed weekly by scripts/update_frameworks.py.

intro.en: Libraries for testing a strategy on historical data in Python. Pick by how you think about strategies: event by event, or whole arrays at once.
intro.zh: 用 Python 在历史数据上测试策略的库。主要看你习惯怎么写策略：逐根K线处理事件，还是一次处理整列数据。

name.zh: 回测到实盘一体化平台

intro.en: Engines that run the same strategy code in backtests and with a real broker or exchange, across several asset classes.
intro.zh: 同一套策略代码既能回测、也能接券商或交易所实盘的引擎，通常支持多个资产类别。

intro.en: Ready-to-run bots for crypto exchanges, with backtesting, paper trading and remote control built in.
intro.zh: 面向加密货币交易所、开箱即用的交易机器人，自带回测、模拟盘和远程控制。

intro.en: Research frameworks that use machine learning, reinforcement learning or language-model agents to make trading decisions.
intro.zh: 用机器学习、强化学习或大语言模型智能体来做交易决策的研究框架。

intro.en: Building blocks most strategies need: market data and technical indicators.
intro.zh: 大多数策略都离不开的基础组件：行情数据和技术指标。

summary.en: Event-driven Python backtesting and live-trading library with a large community.
summary.zh: 事件驱动的 Python 回测和实盘库，社区很大。

description.en: Backtrader runs a strategy bar by bar, the way it would trade live, with brokers, sizers, analyzers and more than a hundred built-in indicators. It became the default choice for Python backtesting in the late 2010s, and a lot of tutorials and Stack Overflow answers still use it. It has seen very little development in recent years (see the last-commit date above), but the code is stable.
description.zh: Backtrader 逐根K线运行策略，和实盘的方式一样，内置经纪商模拟、仓位管理、分析器和一百多个指标。它在 2010 年代后期成了 Python 回测的首选，现在很多教程和问答仍然用它。近几年几乎没有新的开发（见上方的最近提交日期），但代码本身很稳定。

best_for.en: Learning backtesting, strategies with complex order logic, and porting rule-based systems such as MT4/MT5 Expert Advisors.
best_for.zh: 入门学回测、订单逻辑复杂的策略，以及移植 MT4/MT5 EA 这类规则化系统。

en: Realistic event-driven simulation: orders, stops, partial fills, commissions
Huge amount of examples and community answers
Multiple data feeds and timeframes in one strategy
zh: 逼真的事件驱动模拟：挂单、止损、部分成交、手续费都能处理
示例和社区问答非常多
一个策略里可以同时用多个品种、多个周期

en: Slow for large parameter sweeps compared with vectorized libraries
No longer actively developed; plotting can break with newer Matplotlib
Live-trading brokers are dated
zh: 和向量化回测库比，大规模参数扫描很慢
已不再积极维护；新版 Matplotlib 下画图可能出问题
实盘接口比较老旧

our_note.en: Quant Arena's EA Arena runs on Backtrader: 1,063 Expert Advisors converted from MQL5 are re-run every month on four markets of hourly data, about one second per run.
our_note.zh: Quant Arena 的 EA 竞技场就是用 Backtrader 跑的：1,063 个从 MQL5 转换来的 EA，每月在四个品种的小时线上重跑一次，每次大约 1 秒。

summary.en: Vectorized backtesting on pandas and NumPy, built to test thousands of parameter combinations fast.
summary.zh: 基于 pandas 和 NumPy 的向量化回测，专门用来快速测试成千上万组参数。

description.en: vectorbt represents signals, orders and portfolios as arrays and compiles the hot loops with Numba, so testing a whole parameter grid takes seconds. It also ships interactive Plotly charts and a large set of performance statistics. The open-source version is still updated; a separate paid edition, VectorBT PRO, adds more features.
description.zh: vectorbt 把信号、订单和组合都表示成数组，关键循环用 Numba 编译，所以测一整个参数网格只要几秒。它还自带交互式 Plotly 图表和大量绩效统计。开源版仍在更新，另有付费的 VectorBT PRO 提供更多功能。

best_for.en: Research and parameter sweeps on daily or intraday data when speed matters more than order-level detail.
best_for.zh: 在日线或日内数据上做研究、扫参数，速度比订单细节更重要的场景。

en: Very fast: whole parameter grids at once
Rich statistics and interactive charts
Works directly with pandas data
zh: 非常快：可以一次跑完整个参数网格
统计指标丰富，图表可交互
直接用 pandas 数据

en: Path-dependent logic (trailing stops, position-dependent rules) is harder to express
Steep learning curve and a large API
License is Apache 2.0 with the Commons Clause, which restricts selling it as a service
zh: 依赖路径的逻辑（移动止损、跟持仓有关的规则）写起来比较别扭
学习曲线陡，API 很大
许可证是 Apache 2.0 加 Commons Clause，限制把它当服务出售

summary.en: Small, readable backtesting library with interactive charts and a built-in optimizer.
summary.zh: 小巧好读的回测库，自带交互图表和参数优化。

description.en: Backtesting.py keeps the API short: subclass Strategy, write init() and next(), and call Backtest.run(). Results come with an interactive Bokeh chart and a table of standard statistics, and optimize() searches parameters. It tests one instrument at a time.
description.zh: Backtesting.py 的 API 很精简：继承 Strategy，写 init() 和 next()，再调用 Backtest.run()。结果附带交互式 Bokeh 图表和一张常用统计表，optimize() 可以搜索参数。一次只能测一个品种。

best_for.zh: 新手，以及单个品种的快速实验。

en: Easiest API of the libraries here
Good charts out of the box
Built-in parameter optimization and heatmaps
zh: 这里所有库中 API 最简单
开箱即用的图表
内置参数优化和热力图

en: One instrument per backtest; no portfolio of assets
AGPL-3.0 license matters if you build a product on it
Fewer order types than event-driven engines
zh: 每次只能测一个品种，不支持多资产组合
AGPL-3.0 许可证，拿来做产品时要注意
订单类型比事件驱动引擎少

summary.en: Portfolio backtesting built from reusable blocks, for allocation and rebalancing strategies.
summary.zh: 用可复用模块搭建的组合回测库，适合资产配置和再平衡策略。

description.en: bt describes a strategy as a stack of small algorithms (select assets, weigh them, rebalance on a schedule) arranged in a tree, so strategies can hold other strategies. It is built on the ffn performance library and is well suited to monthly or weekly allocation rules rather than intraday trading.
description.zh: bt 把策略拆成一串小算法（选资产、定权重、按周期再平衡），组织成树状结构，策略里还能嵌套策略。它基于 ffn 绩效库，适合按月或按周的配置规则，不适合日内交易。

best_for.en: Asset allocation, risk parity, momentum rotation and other portfolio-level strategies.
best_for.zh: 资产配置、风险平价、动量轮动这类组合层面的策略。

en: Natural fit for multi-asset allocation
Composable building blocks
Clean comparison of several strategies at once
zh: 天然适合多资产配置
模块可以自由组合
可以很方便地同时对比多个策略

en: Not designed for order-level or intraday logic
Smaller community than Backtrader or vectorbt
zh: 不适合订单层面或日内的逻辑
社区比 Backtrader、vectorbt 小

summary.en: Quantopian's event-driven backtester with the Pipeline API; the original repository is no longer maintained.
summary.zh: Quantopian 的事件驱动回测引擎，带 Pipeline API；原仓库已不再维护。

description.en: Zipline powered the Quantopian platform, which closed in 2020. Its Pipeline API for cross-sectional factor screens is still admired, and it appears in well-known books on machine learning for trading. The original repository has not been updated for years and is hard to install on current Python; community forks keep it running.
description.zh: Zipline 曾是 Quantopian 平台的核心，该平台已在 2020 年关闭。它用于横截面因子筛选的 Pipeline API 至今仍受好评，也出现在一些知名的机器学习交易书籍里。原仓库多年没有更新，在新版 Python 上很难安装，目前靠社区分支维持。

best_for.en: Following older tutorials and books that use it, and cross-sectional equity factor research.
best_for.zh: 跟着使用它的老教程和书学习，以及股票横截面因子研究。

en: Pipeline API for factor research
Realistic daily equity simulation
Lots of historical learning material
zh: 适合因子研究的 Pipeline API
对股票日线的模拟比较真实
历史学习资料很多

en: Original repository unmaintained; installation is painful
Data bundles need setup work
Not suited to crypto or forex
zh: 原仓库无人维护，安装很麻烦
数据包需要额外配置
不适合加密货币和外汇

summary.en: Early event-driven Python backtester, now archived by its author.
summary.zh: 较早的 Python 事件驱动回测库，作者已将其归档。

description.en: PyAlgoTrade was one of the first popular Python backtesting libraries, with event-driven backtests, paper trading and technical indicators. The repository is archived, so it receives no fixes. It is listed here because it still shows up in tutorials; new projects should pick a maintained library.
description.zh: PyAlgoTrade 是最早流行的 Python 回测库之一，支持事件驱动回测、模拟交易和技术指标。仓库已经归档，不会再有修复。之所以列在这里，是因为很多教程里还能看到它；新项目建议选还在维护的库。

best_for.en: Reading old code. Not recommended for new work.
best_for.zh: 阅读老代码。不建议用于新项目。

en: Simple, readable design
zh: 设计简单，代码易读

en: Archived: no bug fixes or updates
Limited support for current Python versions
zh: 已归档：不再修复或更新
对新版 Python 支持有限

summary.en: QuantConnect's open-source engine: C# core, Python strategies, many asset classes, backtest and live.
summary.zh: QuantConnect 的开源引擎：C# 内核，可用 Python 写策略，支持多资产，回测实盘一体。

description.en: LEAN is the engine behind QuantConnect. Strategies are written in Python or C# and can trade equities, options, futures, forex and crypto, in backtests or live through supported brokerages. It runs locally through the LEAN CLI or in QuantConnect's cloud, where historical data is available; running locally means finding and formatting your own data.
description.zh: LEAN 是 QuantConnect 背后的引擎。策略用 Python 或 C# 编写，可以交易股票、期权、期货、外汇和加密货币，既能回测，也能通过支持的券商实盘。可以用 LEAN CLI 在本地运行，也可以在 QuantConnect 云端运行（云端有历史数据）；本地运行则需要自己准备和整理数据。

best_for.en: Serious multi-asset strategies, especially with options or futures, that should go live with a broker.
best_for.zh: 要上实盘的严肃多资产策略，尤其是涉及期权、期货的。

en: Very broad asset and brokerage coverage
Same code for research, backtest and live
Mature, actively developed, large user base
zh: 资产和券商覆盖非常广
研究、回测、实盘用同一套代码
成熟、持续开发、用户多

en: Heavier to set up locally than a Python library
Local data is your job; the convenient data is in the paid cloud
Framework conventions take time to learn
zh: 本地搭建比纯 Python 库重得多
本地数据要自己解决，方便的数据在付费云端
框架约定需要时间学习

summary.en: High-performance, event-driven trading platform with a Rust core and a Python API.
summary.zh: 高性能的事件驱动交易平台，Rust 内核加 Python API。

description.en: NautilusTrader is built for production: the core is written in Rust, strategies in Python, and the same strategy runs in backtests and live with no code changes. It handles order books and tick data and has adapters for crypto exchanges, Interactive Brokers and several data vendors. It is one of the most actively developed projects in this list.
description.zh: NautilusTrader 面向生产环境设计：内核用 Rust 写，策略用 Python 写，同一个策略不改代码就能在回测和实盘之间切换。它支持订单簿和逐笔数据，有加密货币交易所、盈透证券和多个数据商的接口，是这份名单里开发最活跃的项目之一。

best_for.en: Developers building high-frequency or order-book strategies who want backtest and live parity.
best_for.zh: 做高频或订单簿策略、希望回测和实盘完全一致的开发者。

en: Fast, realistic event-driven simulation down to the order book
Backtest and live use identical code
Very active development
zh: 快速且逼真的事件驱动模拟，可以细到订单簿
回测和实盘代码完全相同
开发非常活跃

en: Steep learning curve; built for engineers
API changes often between releases
LGPL-3.0 license
zh: 学习曲线陡，主要面向工程师
版本之间 API 变化频繁
LGPL-3.0 许可证

summary.en: The most widely used open-source quant trading platform in China, now branded VeighNa.
summary.zh: 国内使用最广的开源量化交易平台，现在的品牌名是 VeighNa。

description.en: vn.py is a Python platform with a desktop GUI, backtesting, and gateways to Chinese futures (CTP), stocks, options and international brokers. It is built from apps such as CTA strategy, spread trading and portfolio strategy that can be combined. Documentation and community are mainly in Chinese.
description.zh: vn.py 是一个带桌面图形界面的 Python 平台，支持回测，并有国内期货（CTP）、股票、期权和海外券商的接口。功能以应用模块的形式组织，比如 CTA 策略、价差交易、组合策略，可以按需组合。文档和社区以中文为主。

best_for.en: Trading Chinese futures and stocks, and teams that want a GUI trading desk.
best_for.zh: 交易国内期货和股票，以及需要图形界面交易终端的团队。

en: Best connectivity to Chinese markets
GUI plus scripting
Large Chinese-speaking community and courses
zh: 对国内市场的接口最全
既有图形界面也能写脚本
中文社区和课程很多

en: Documentation mostly in Chinese
Desktop-oriented design
Some advanced modules and courses are commercial
zh: 文档以中文为主
偏桌面端设计
部分高级模块和课程收费

summary.en: The most popular open-source crypto trading bot, with backtesting, hyperparameter search and machine learning.
summary.zh: 最流行的开源加密货币交易机器人，带回测、超参数搜索和机器学习。

description.en: Freqtrade runs strategies written in Python against dozens of exchanges through CCXT. It includes backtesting, a hyperopt module for parameter search, dry-run (paper) trading, control through Telegram or a web UI, and FreqAI for adaptive machine-learning models. It is designed for directional strategies on candles rather than market making.
description.zh: Freqtrade 通过 CCXT 连接几十家交易所，运行用 Python 写的策略。它包含回测、用来搜索参数的 hyperopt 模块、模拟盘（dry-run）、Telegram 或网页控制，以及用于自适应机器学习模型的 FreqAI。它主要面向基于K线的方向性策略，不是做市。

best_for.en: Running your own trend or mean-reversion strategies on crypto spot and futures.
best_for.zh: 在加密货币现货和合约上运行自己的趋势或均值回归策略。

en: Complete toolkit from backtest to live
Large community and many example strategies
Very active development
zh: 从回测到实盘一应俱全
社区大，示例策略多
开发非常活跃

en: Crypto only
Hyperopt makes overfitting easy; check results out of sample
GPL-3.0 license
zh: 只支持加密货币
hyperopt 很容易过拟合，结果一定要做样本外检验
GPL-3.0 许可证

our_note.en: Hyperopt picks the best parameters on past data. Our walk-forward tests show why that needs care: across 486 strategy-and-market pairs, the median Sharpe ratio fell from 0.32 in sample to 0.19 out of sample.
our_note.zh: hyperopt 会在历史数据上挑出最优参数。我们的滚动前推测试说明了为什么要小心：在 486 个“策略 × 市场”组合里，夏普中位数从样本内的 0.32 降到了样本外的 0.19。

summary.en: Open-source framework for market making and arbitrage bots on centralized and decentralized exchanges.
summary.zh: 在中心化和去中心化交易所上做市、套利的开源机器人框架。

description.en: Hummingbot focuses on liquidity-providing strategies: pure market making, cross-exchange market making and arbitrage. It has connectors for many centralized exchanges and DEXs, and a newer framework for scripted strategies and controllers. It is less suited to classic candle-based signals.
description.zh: Hummingbot 专注于提供流动性的策略：纯做市、跨交易所做市和套利。它连接了很多中心化交易所和去中心化交易所，并有较新的脚本策略和控制器框架。它不太适合经典的基于K线信号的策略。

best_for.en: Market making and arbitrage, including on DEXs.
best_for.zh: 做市和套利，包括在去中心化交易所上。

en: Strong exchange and DEX connectivity
Purpose-built market-making strategies
Active open-source foundation behind it
zh: 交易所和 DEX 接口丰富
专门为做市设计的策略
背后有活跃的开源基金会

en: Backtesting of market making is limited compared with candle strategies
Market making needs capital and careful risk control
Not aimed at directional trading
zh: 做市策略的回测能力不如K线策略完整
做市需要资金和细致的风控
不面向方向性交易

summary.en: Crypto trading framework focused on simple strategy syntax and accurate backtests.
summary.zh: 加密货币交易框架，主打简洁的策略写法和准确的回测。

description.en: Jesse lets you write crypto strategies in compact Python, with built-in indicators, multiple timeframes and symbols, and a web dashboard for backtests and optimization. It puts emphasis on avoiding look-ahead bias in backtests.
description.zh: Jesse 让你用很紧凑的 Python 写加密货币策略，内置指标，支持多周期、多品种，并有网页控制台用来回测和优化。它特别注重避免回测中的未来函数。

best_for.en: Crypto traders who want cleaner strategy code than Freqtrade.
best_for.zh: 希望策略代码比 Freqtrade 更简洁的加密货币交易者。

en: Readable strategy syntax
Care about look-ahead bias
Web dashboard
zh: 策略写法清晰易读
重视避免未来函数
有网页控制台

en: Crypto only
Smaller community than Freqtrade
zh: 只支持加密货币
社区比 Freqtrade 小

summary.en: Microsoft's AI-oriented quant investment platform for building and testing machine-learning alpha models.
summary.zh: 微软开源的 AI 量化投资平台，用来构建和测试机器学习选股模型。

description.en: Qlib covers the whole research loop for machine-learning stock selection: a fast data layer, feature engineering, a model zoo (gradient boosting, LSTM, transformers and more), portfolio construction and backtesting. Its examples are built mostly around Chinese A-share data.
description.zh: Qlib 覆盖机器学习选股的整个研究流程：高效的数据层、特征工程、模型库（梯度提升、LSTM、Transformer 等）、组合构建和回测。它的示例主要基于 A 股数据。

best_for.en: Researchers building cross-sectional stock-selection models with machine learning.
best_for.zh: 用机器学习做横截面选股模型的研究者。

en: End-to-end ML research workflow
Many reference models and benchmarks
Backed by Microsoft Research, MIT license
zh: 端到端的机器学习研究流程
参考模型和基准很多
微软研究院出品，MIT 许可证

en: Equity factor research, not trading execution
Default data focuses on China A-shares
Needs solid ML background
zh: 偏股票因子研究，不负责交易执行
默认数据以 A 股为主
需要扎实的机器学习基础

summary.en: Deep reinforcement learning library for trading research and teaching.
summary.zh: 用于交易研究和教学的深度强化学习库。

description.en: FinRL wraps market data into reinforcement-learning environments and trains agents with standard algorithms such as PPO, A2C and SAC for stock trading, portfolio allocation and crypto. It is mainly a research and education project with many notebooks; reported results depend heavily on the test period and settings.
description.zh: FinRL 把行情数据封装成强化学习环境，用 PPO、A2C、SAC 等标准算法训练智能体，做股票交易、组合配置和加密货币交易。它主要是研究和教学项目，有大量 notebook；论文和示例里的结果非常依赖测试区间和设置。

best_for.en: Learning and experimenting with reinforcement learning on market data.
best_for.zh: 学习、尝试把强化学习用在行情数据上。

en: Many ready-made environments and tutorials
Covers several RL algorithms
Active academic community
zh: 现成的环境和教程很多
覆盖多种强化学习算法
学术社区活跃

en: Research code, not a production trading system
RL results are easy to overfit; out-of-sample checks are essential
Mostly Jupyter notebooks
zh: 是研究代码，不是生产级交易系统
强化学习的结果很容易过拟合，一定要做样本外检验
以 Jupyter notebook 为主

summary.en: Multi-agent framework where language-model agents act as analysts, researchers, a trader and a risk team.
summary.zh: 多智能体框架：用大语言模型扮演分析师、研究员、交易员和风控团队。

description.en: TradingAgents splits a trading decision across several LLM agents: analysts read fundamentals, news, sentiment and technicals, bullish and bearish researchers debate, a trader proposes a position and a risk team reviews it. It runs on commercial or local language-model APIs, so each decision costs tokens, and it is presented by its authors as a research framework rather than investment advice.
description.zh: TradingAgents 把一次交易决策拆给多个大语言模型智能体：分析师分别看基本面、新闻、情绪和技术面，多空研究员互相辩论，交易员给出仓位建议，再由风控团队审核。它调用商业或本地的大模型接口，每次决策都要消耗 token；作者把它定位为研究框架，不是投资建议。

best_for.en: Exploring how LLM agents reason about stocks; research and demos.
best_for.zh: 研究大语言模型智能体怎么分析股票，适合研究和演示。

en: Readable reasoning for every decision
Modular agent roles and model choice
Huge community interest
zh: 每个决策都有可读的推理过程
智能体角色和所用模型可以替换
社区关注度极高

en: Hard to backtest over long periods: LLM calls are slow and costly, and models may already know the outcome of past events
Results vary between runs and models
Not a substitute for a systematic, testable rule
zh: 很难做长周期回测：调用大模型又慢又贵，而且模型可能已经知道历史事件的结果
不同运行、不同模型的结果会有差异
不能替代可检验的系统化规则

our_note.en: The look-ahead problem is real: a language model trained on data up to a recent date may already know what happened in the period you backtest. Any LLM strategy result needs a test period after the model's training cutoff.
our_note.zh: 未来函数的问题是真实存在的：用某个日期之前的数据训练的大模型，可能已经“知道”你回测期间发生了什么。任何大模型策略的结果，都需要在模型训练截止日期之后的区间里检验。

summary.en: One API for market data and trading on more than a hundred crypto exchanges.
summary.zh: 用一套 API 访问一百多家加密货币交易所的行情和交易。

description.en: CCXT gives the same methods for fetching candles, order books and balances and for placing orders across a very large number of exchanges, in Python, JavaScript, PHP and other languages. Many crypto bots, including Freqtrade, are built on it.
description.zh: CCXT 为大量交易所提供统一的方法来获取K线、订单簿、余额和下单，支持 Python、JavaScript、PHP 等多种语言。包括 Freqtrade 在内的很多加密货币机器人都基于它。

best_for.en: Downloading crypto data and connecting your own code to exchanges.
best_for.zh: 下载加密货币数据，把自己的代码接到交易所。

en: Unmatched exchange coverage
Same interface in several languages
Very actively maintained
zh: 交易所覆盖面无人能比
多种语言接口一致
维护非常积极

en: Not a strategy or backtesting framework
Exchange quirks still leak through the unified API
zh: 不是策略或回测框架
统一接口下仍会遇到各交易所自己的特殊情况

summary.en: Free download of Yahoo Finance prices and fundamentals into pandas.
summary.zh: 把 Yahoo Finance 的行情和基本面数据免费下载到 pandas。

description.en: yfinance is the most common way to get free daily and intraday price history for stocks, ETFs, currencies and crypto in Python. It is unofficial: Yahoo can change its site or rate-limit requests, and the data is meant for personal use under Yahoo's terms.
description.zh: yfinance 是 Python 里获取股票、ETF、外汇和加密货币免费日线和日内历史数据最常用的方法。它不是官方接口：Yahoo 可能改版或限流，数据按 Yahoo 的条款仅供个人使用。

best_for.en: Personal research and prototypes on daily data.
best_for.zh: 基于日线的个人研究和原型开发。

en: Free and easy
Broad coverage of tickers
Adjusted prices for dividends and splits
zh: 免费、好用
覆盖的代码很多
提供按分红拆股调整后的价格

en: Unofficial; can break or be rate-limited without notice
Adjusted history changes after dividends, so old backtests shift slightly
Not licensed for redistribution
zh: 非官方接口，可能随时失效或被限流
分红后复权历史会变化，旧回测结果会有小幅变动
数据不允许再分发

our_note.en: Quant Arena's daily strategy data comes from yfinance. Between two builds a day apart we found that 198 of 576 equity curves had small changes deep in their history, partly because Yahoo revises adjusted prices after dividends.
our_note.zh: Quant Arena 的策略日线数据就来自 yfinance。我们实测过：相隔一天的两次构建之间，576 条权益曲线里有 198 条的早期历史出现了小幅变化，部分原因就是 Yahoo 在分红后会修订复权价格。

summary.en: Python wrapper for TA-Lib, the classic C library of 150+ technical indicators and candlestick patterns.
summary.zh: 经典技术指标 C 库 TA-Lib 的 Python 封装，包含 150 多个指标和K线形态。

description.en: TA-Lib computes moving averages, oscillators, volatility measures and candlestick pattern recognition quickly in C, and the Python wrapper works on NumPy arrays and pandas Series. Its indicator definitions are a common reference, which makes results comparable with other platforms.
description.zh: TA-Lib 用 C 语言快速计算均线、震荡指标、波动率和K线形态识别，Python 封装可以直接处理 NumPy 数组和 pandas Series。它的指标定义是业内常用的参考，计算结果容易和其他平台对照。

best_for.en: Fast, standard indicator calculations in any Python strategy.
best_for.zh: 在任何 Python 策略里快速、标准地计算指标。

en: Fast C implementation
Standard, widely used definitions
Candlestick pattern recognition
zh: C 语言实现，速度快
指标定义标准、通用
支持K线形态识别

en: Installation historically required building the C library first
Indicators only; no backtesting
zh: 过去安装时需要先编译 C 库
只算指标，不能回测

verdict.en: Choose Backtrader when order-level realism matters (stops, partial fills, complex position rules) or when you port an existing rule-based system. Choose vectorbt when you need to test thousands of parameter combinations quickly. Many people prototype in vectorbt and confirm the final rules in an event-driven engine.
verdict.zh: 如果你在意订单层面的真实性（止损、部分成交、复杂的持仓规则），或者要移植现成的规则化系统，选 Backtrader；如果需要快速测试成千上万组参数，选 vectorbt。很多人先用 vectorbt 做原型，再在事件驱动引擎里验证最终规则。

verdict.en: Backtesting.py is the faster start: a short API and good charts, but one instrument at a time. Backtrader takes longer to learn but handles several data feeds, timeframes and detailed order logic.
verdict.zh: Backtesting.py 上手更快：API 简短、图表好看，但一次只能测一个品种。Backtrader 学起来更费时间，但能处理多个品种、多个周期和细致的订单逻辑。

verdict.en: They solve different problems. Freqtrade runs directional strategies on candles (trend, mean reversion, ML signals). Hummingbot provides liquidity: market making and arbitrage, including on DEXs.
verdict.zh: 两者解决的是不同的问题。Freqtrade 运行基于K线的方向性策略（趋势、均值回归、机器学习信号）；Hummingbot 提供流动性，做市和套利，也支持去中心化交易所。

verdict.en: Both run candle-based crypto strategies. Freqtrade has the bigger community, more exchanges and FreqAI; Jesse has cleaner strategy code and a strong focus on backtest accuracy.
verdict.zh: 两者都运行基于K线的加密货币策略。Freqtrade 社区更大、支持的交易所更多，还有 FreqAI；Jesse 的策略代码更简洁，也更强调回测的准确性。

verdict.en: LEAN is the broader, more established platform, especially for options and futures and with QuantConnect's cloud data. NautilusTrader is faster and closer to the metal, aimed at order-book and high-frequency strategies, with a steeper learning curve.
verdict.zh: LEAN 覆盖更广、更成熟，尤其适合期权期货，还能用 QuantConnect 的云端数据。NautilusTrader 更快、更贴近底层，面向订单簿和高频策略，学习曲线也更陡。

verdict.en: Qlib is for supervised machine learning: predict which stocks will do better, then build a portfolio. FinRL is for reinforcement learning: train an agent that decides trades directly. Qlib is closer to how quant equity teams work; FinRL is more of a research and teaching tool.
verdict.zh: Qlib 做的是监督学习：预测哪些股票表现更好，再构建组合；FinRL 做的是强化学习：训练一个直接决定交易的智能体。Qlib 更接近量化股票团队的实际做法，FinRL 更偏研究和教学。

verdict.en: For a new project, Backtrader is easier to install and still works on current Python. Zipline is worth it mainly for its Pipeline API and for following books that use it, through a maintained community fork.
verdict.zh: 新项目选 Backtrader 更省事，在新版 Python 上也还能用。Zipline 主要值在它的 Pipeline API，以及跟着用它的书学习；这时建议用仍在维护的社区分支。
